# 路徑速度附魔

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1327308441324097681?label=discord&color=blue&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/5UdcDa5xNC)
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/path-speed-enchantment?label=modrinth&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/path-speed-enchantment)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/lullaby6/data-packs)](https://github.com/lullaby6/data-packs/blob/main/LICENSE)

`路徑速度` 是一款專為靴子設計的附魔，共有三個等級，能夠提升你在泥土路徑上的移動速度，效果類似靈魂疾行附魔。

此附魔可透過附魔台、戰利品箱或與村民交易獲得。

## ⌨️ 指令

給予：

```mcfunction
/loot give @s loot path_speed_enchantment:<level>
```

附魔：

```mcfunction
/enchant @s path_speed_enchantment:path_speed <level>
```

## 🪪 授權條款

[AGPL-3.0-or-later](https://github.com/lullaby6/data-packs/blob/main/LICENSE)
